statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitor study, CPT code 93226, was ordered
The Holter monitor was ordered to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to the patient's symptoms
The Holter monitor was ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular pathology
The denial reason code is CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary according to current coverage guidelines and clinical criteria
The Holter monitor is medically necessary to document clinically significant arrhythmias associated with the patient's symptoms and underlying cardiovascular disease
